data.name: Arth
data.gender_notes: Arth is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arth signifies wealth or prosperity. In Hindu mythology, it is a name of the god Indra, who is known as the deity of rain and thunder. In Sanskrit, Arth also means 'truth' or 'reality'. The name Arth carries the meaning “Wealth, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arth usually hope their child will grow to embody wealth, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of material and spiritual wealth.
data.etymology: Arth belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wealth, Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arth total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
